coverage_gaps: datastore: none present (in-memory page cache only — no DB/cache/queue components to enumerate)
external-service: none present (no network crates in Cargo.lock; verified no reqwest/ureq/hyper/tokio/openssl/rustls)
binary: none present (no std::process/Command/spawn call sites in src/)
container-os: host Fedora 44 system library versions captured from audit host; no Dockerfile/OCI packaging exists in repo
package versions: resolved from Cargo.lock (authoritative for all 236 crates); transitive set beyond direct+decoder/compression deps not individually enumerated
webp crate (0.3.x): not in dependency tree — image crate uses image-webp 0.2.4; CVE-2023-4863 range for Rust webp crate not applicable
